# cmccloudv2_vip (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# create vip with manual ip address
resource "cmccloudv2_vip" "vip1" {
    subnet_id  = "8de5d47e-ff2b-4390-8333-fbf3d775341a"
    ip_address = "192.168.0.10"
}
# create vip with auto ip address
resource "cmccloudv2_vip" "vip2" {
    subnet_id  = "8de5d47e-ff2b-4390-8333-fbf3d775341a" 
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet_id` (String) The ID of the subnet to attach the VIP to

### Optional

- `ip_address` (String) The IP address of the VIP to create
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
